string-array.name: screensaver_quotes
string-array.item: The quieter you become, the more you hear.
Night is the other half of the day.
Somewhere, the sun is always rising.
Slow down; the evening is in no hurry.
Every lit window holds a small world.
Rest is part of the work.
A little darkness is what makes the stars.
Let the day end without a verdict.
The room grows quiet, and so do I.
Time is the one thing we spend without counting.
Tomorrow will arrive on its own.
